opportunities.title: Config load aborts on one bad entry, then save overwrites with partial state
opportunities.description: A wrong field type in a workspace/group/launcher throws during load; the next debounced save writes the partial state over config.json, losing user data. Rust skips only the bad entry.

opportunities.title: Hook payload with non-string session_id/permission_mode crashes the reducer
opportunities.description: Dart casts as String; Rust treats non-strings as absent.

opportunities.title: Alt+1..9 leaks ESC+digit to the program on Linux
opportunities.description: Session switch keys are not intercepted inside the terminal on Linux.

opportunities.title: TERM inherited from launching terminal
opportunities.description: Maestria never sets TERM; app launched from a terminal passes that TERM through. Rust sets xterm-256color explicitly.

opportunities.description: alacritty_terminal fixes most natively; keep the byte-level CSI > m scrubber and port the tests.
